flashcard_questions.q: How many hospitals were there in England by 1500?
What proportion of medieval hospitals actually cared for the sick?
Which plant grown in monastery herb gardens was used to treat 'feebleness of the heart'?
Which chemical taken from that plant is still used in modern heart medicine?
How many trained physicians were there in the whole of England by 1300?
Who was the Franciscan friar imprisoned for arguing that doctors should experiment rather than follow Galen?
Which Persian physician was the first to tell smallpox and measles apart?
How many medical texts did Rhazes write?
Which book by Ibn Sina became the standard medical textbook in European universities?
For how long was Ibn Sina's great encyclopaedia used as Europe's standard medical textbook?
How many different drugs were described in Ibn Sina's Canon of Medicine?
Which Syrian physician rejected Galen and argued that blood passed through the lungs?
In which year did William Harvey prove the full circulation of the blood?
What was the House of Wisdom in Baghdad?
flashcard_questions.a: A great centre of learning that attracted scholars from across the world.
